profile.name: JasMehr Singh
profile.bio: I run campaigns, content and brand partnerships by day, and ship AI tools with Claude Code by night. I have driven 1M+ views on short-form video I wrote and shot myself, grown owned channels to 10M+ Pinterest impressions, and founded two independent brands from zero. Currently pursuing an MBA at LM Thapar School of Management, specialising in Marketing.

experience.summary: Launch-phase growth for MyMints, a hyperlocal commerce platform.
highlights: Onboarded 10+ local vendor partners through field outreach and training during the platform's launch phase.
Produced reels and digital content generating 1M+ combined views across partner locations.
Planned and executed three seasonal campaigns end-to-end: Ambassador Program, Valentine's Day and Holi.

experience.summary: Two independent ventures built and run from zero.
highlights: Launched Glood.co, a custom merchandise brand, and sold 1,000+ units through campus stalls and online channels.
Built 3 to 4 cross-brand partnerships to expand distribution and audience reach.
Founded PawHow.in, a pet-products content and affiliate platform; grew owned channels to 10M+ Pinterest impressions.

experience.summary: Owned communications and event delivery for the university sustainability club.
highlights: Coordinated sustainability programmes across the university community.
Standardised newsletter, social and event collateral templates to hold brand consistency.
Promoted from Content Writer after a year of consistent output and event delivery.

experience.summary: Content and social ownership for a SaaS content platform.
highlights: Owned the company LinkedIn page and produced content for a brand-awareness campaign that lifted engagement.
Collaborated cross-functionally on a new product feature while managing multiple deadlines.

experience.summary: Multi-city event operations for large student debate circuits.
highlights: Delivered multi-day debate events reaching 1,500+ students across four cities.
Coordinated venue logistics, staffing, sponsors and schedules end-to-end.
Ran structured post-event reviews and converted findings into action plans for the next edition.

experience.summary: School entrepreneurship programme running a real product line.
highlights: Handled marketing and door-to-door sales for a wall-mount product line.
Ran market research to identify opportunities and inform strategy.

projects.title: ClipForge
projects.subtitle: AI video repurposing pipeline
projects.description: Turns long videos into captioned short clips automatically using LLM-based highlight detection, transcription and vertical reframing. Directed and iterated end-to-end with Claude Code.

projects.title: Agent OS
projects.subtitle: Governed agent platform
projects.description: A platform for running AI agents under explicit rules, with Post Studio for drafting content in my own voice. Covered by 1,800+ automated tests.

projects.title: Venture Adda
projects.subtitle: Student marketplace for campus ventures
projects.description: A marketplace for student-run ventures on campus. Each venture gets its own storefront, every product gets its own shareable page, and a moderated billboard features what is on offer. In active development.

projects.title: ASCEND
projects.subtitle: Life-management dashboard with an AI coach
projects.description: Habit stacking, discipline scoring and an AI coaching layer in a liquid-glass UI. Built in React and Firebase to run a full personal operating system in one place.

projects.title: Habit Arena
projects.subtitle: Multiplayer habit-tracking game
projects.description: Gamified habit tracker with streaks, arenas and competitive self-improvement mechanics. Turns consistency into something you play rather than something you endure.

projects.title: Content-OS
projects.subtitle: An operating system for creators
projects.description: Pipeline management, scheduling and asset organisation for a multi-channel content operation. Built to stop losing ideas between the note app and the upload.

projects.title: RezClips
projects.subtitle: Smart video clipping & summarisation
projects.description: Pulls highlights and key moments out of long-form content automatically. An earlier exploration of the problem ClipForge now solves end-to-end.

services.title: Content & Copywriting
services.body: Short-form video scripts, landing copy, blog and social content built around hooks that actually hold attention, not filler written to fill a calendar.

services.title: Growth & SEO
services.body: Organic growth from keyword research through publishing and iteration. Semrush-certified, with 10M+ Pinterest impressions on channels I ran myself.

services.title: AI Automation
services.body: Custom internal tools built with Claude Code, video repurposing pipelines, content dashboards, workflow automation. I direct the product; the AI writes the code.

services.title: Brand Partnerships
services.body: Influencer and vendor outreach end-to-end: list building, cold outreach, negotiation and activation. 10+ vendor partners onboarded at launch stage.
